title: Remove Box::leak from take_vars in config tests
description:
What: Replace Box::leak in config.rs test helper take_vars with String keys to avoid unnecessary memory leaks.

Why: take_vars returns Vec<(&'static str, Option<String>)> using Box::leak to extend lifetime of env var name strings. This is unnecessary — changing the key type to String removes the need entirely.

Algorithm:
1. In kithd/src/config.rs, find take_vars() (around line 187).
   Current signature: fn take_vars(names: &[&str]) -> Vec<(&'static str, Option<String>)>
2. Change return type to: Vec<(String, Option<String>)>
3. Replace the Box::leak line with: (name.to_string(), prev)
4. Find restore_vars() (around line 204).
   Current signature: fn restore_vars(saved: Vec<(&str, Option<String>)>)
5. Change parameter type to: Vec<(String, Option<String>)>
6. In restore_vars body, change each name usage to name.as_str() or &name as needed for set_var/remove_var.
7. Find all call sites of take_vars and restore_vars — update if needed.
8. Run cargo fmt, cargo test -p kithd.

Defensive rules:
- std::env::set_var and remove_var both accept AsRef<OsStr> so String works directly.
- Do not change any test logic — only the helper signatures and internals.
- Remove the comment that says 'We need a static key -- leak is fine' since that is no longer true.

Closes: KITH-v7t.9
